skill.name: receiving-code-review
skill.description: Guides assistants through code review feedback with verification, clarification, technical pushback, and careful implementation order.
skill.summary: Evaluate code review feedback carefully before changing code.
skill.author: DYAI2025

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences and prose examples being interpreted as shell backtick execution. No prompt injection, data exfiltration, destructive behavior, or command execution intent was found in SKILL.md. The only confirmed issue is the unscanned SKILL.zip archive, which should be manually verified before publication.

remediation.suggestion: Unpack SKILL.zip and verify that it contains only the reviewed SKILL.md content and no hidden scripts, binaries, or additional instructions.

content.value_statement: Code review feedback can be unclear, incomplete, or technically wrong for the current codebase. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code verify feedback before making focused changes.
actual_capabilities: Prompts the assistant to read and understand all review feedback before acting.
Encourages clarification when review items are unclear or related.
Guides technical verification against the current codebase before implementation.
Defines when to push back on suggestions that break behavior or violate project needs.
Recommends an implementation order for multi-item review feedback.
Provides response examples for correct, unclear, and questionable feedback.
limitations: Does not run tests, inspect code, or verify feedback by itself.
Depends on the assistant having access to the relevant repository context.
May not fit teams that prefer highly formal or gratitude-heavy review responses.
Does not replace human judgment for architectural or product decisions.

use_cases.title: Handle unclear pull request feedback
use_cases.description: Clarify missing details before starting changes so related review items are not implemented incorrectly.
use_cases.target_user: Software engineers using AI coding assistants

use_cases.title: Evaluate external reviewer suggestions
use_cases.description: Check whether suggested changes fit the codebase before accepting them as implementation tasks.

use_cases.title: Keep AI agents focused during review fixes
use_cases.description: Guide Claude Code or Codex to fix one review item at a time and verify each change.

prompt_templates.title: Clarify review feedback
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for unclear review comments.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the receiving-code-review skill. Read this feedback, restate what is clear, and list the items that need clarification before implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a reviewer suggestion
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for checking one technical recommendation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the receiving-code-review skill. Check whether this reviewer suggestion is correct for this codebase before making any change.

prompt_templates.title: Plan multi-item review fixes
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for several review comments.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the receiving-code-review skill. Group these review items by blocking issues, simple fixes, and complex fixes, then propose the implementation order.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare technical pushback
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the receiving-code-review skill. If this feedback is technically wrong or conflicts with existing behavior, draft concise technical pushback with evidence.

output_examples.input: Reviewer says to remove legacy code, but the app may still support older platforms.
output_examples.output: The assistant checks platform targets first, explains whether legacy support is still required, and asks whether to fix or remove it.

output_examples.input: Reviewer says to fix items 1 through 6, but items 4 and 5 are ambiguous.
output_examples.output: The assistant states which items are understood and asks for clarification before implementing any related changes.

output_examples.input: Reviewer requests a full metrics feature for an endpoint with unknown usage.
output_examples.output: The assistant checks actual usage, then asks whether to remove the unused endpoint or implement the requested feature.

best_practices: Read all review feedback before changing code.
Verify suggestions against tests, usage, and platform constraints.
Implement review fixes one item at a time and test each change.
anti_patterns: Accepting review comments without checking whether they fit the codebase.
Starting partial implementation when some review items are unclear.
Adding unused features only because a reviewer described a more complete design.

faq.question: Does this skill automatically fix review comments?
faq.answer: No. It guides the assistant to understand, verify, and plan fixes before implementation.

faq.question: Can it help with GitHub pull request reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It is useful for interpreting pull request comments and deciding the safest response.

faq.question: Does it support Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists Claude Code, Claude, and Codex as supported tools.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it before implementing review feedback, especially when comments are unclear or technically questionable.

faq.question: Will it push back on human reviewers?
faq.answer: It can help draft technical pushback when evidence shows the suggestion is wrong or harmful.

faq.question: Does it replace tests or manual verification?
faq.answer: No. It recommends verification, but the assistant or developer must still run the right checks.
